source.name: CF Montréal – 'CF Montréal unveils new primary jersey'
source.quote: BMO Financial Group, CF Montréal's main partner, is once again featured prominently in the centre of the jersey for a 14th consecutive MLS season.

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: CF Montreal | Apple TV | Media | Telus | Telecommunications

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey, while 24 teams feature a brand logo on the right sleeves of their jerseys

summary: Blue-and-black striped 'Montréal Original' home kit, worn since 2025. BMO is on the front for a 14th straight MLS season; Telus has the right sleeve and the Apple TV league patch the left.
